scientific_scope: CPU-only deterministic self-parity; no CUDA/PAN/learning/structural-plasticity equivalence claim

seed_strategy.rule: frozen unique integer seeds; each seed is executed once in replicate_A and once in replicate_B; no seed replacement after inspection

stopping_rule: complete both paired repeats for all 20 frozen seeds; do not stop early for matches or mismatches
inclusion_criteria: clean source freeze bound before execution
identical protocol/config/input/initial-state contract between paired repeats
STDP, reward learning and topology adaptation disabled
exclusion_criteria: source/config digest differs between paired repeats
runtime/provenance failure that prevents the declared observations from being produced

descriptive_statistics: mismatch class: spike sequence, terminal state, event queue, or fingerprint
analysis_plan.inference_policy: The preregistered hypothesis is supported at DATA-analysis level only if all 20 paired seeds match exactly on both primary outcomes. Any primary mismatch refutes exact self-parity for this protocol. No p-value substitution is used for an exact deterministic contract.
planned_tests: paired exact equality of ordered spike-event sequences
paired exact equality of canonical final-state digests
analysis_plan.multiplicity: two co-primary outcomes; both must pass for every seed

expected_failure_modes: timing/telemetry field accidentally included in scientific state digest

structural_governance.reason: isolate CPU self-parity from structural mutation

ai_treatment.authority_boundary: AI cannot change seeds, protocol, inclusion/exclusion, DATA, review status or EVID.

execution.authorization_rule: bind exact source commit and protocol/config digests after merge; execution authorization is a separate recorded action
